from.place: proof, the Koszul resolution on the regular sequence x_0,x_1

title: Exact graded Koszul resolution for k[x_0,x_1]
statement: For a field k and S=k[x_0,x_1] graded by total degree, using [def-sc-p1-standard], the graded complex 0 \to S(-2) --(x_1,-x_0)\to S(-1) direct sum S(-1) --(x_0,x_1)\to S \to k \to 0 is exact, where S(e) is the shifted graded module [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf] (2), k=S/(x_0,x_1) and every displayed map is homogeneous of degree zero.

source.place: statement, source note: graded global dimension two of S=k[x_0,x_1] (Koszul resolution of k on the regular sequence x_0,x_1)

proof.text: Define the S-linear maps f by the product of right multiplication by x_1 and the negative of right multiplication by x_0, g by the coproduct of right multiplication by x_0 and x_1, and q as the ideal quotient linear map. Their displayed formulas follow by evaluation. Commutativity gives g(f(a))=0 by expansion.

source.place: statement, source note: graded global dimension two of S=k[x_0,x_1] (Koszul resolution of k on the regular sequence x_0,x_1)

proof.text: The polynomial ring over k is a domain by [lem-weil-pbc-polynomial-ring-domain]. Equality f(a)=f(b) implies ax_1=bx_1 by the first coordinate. Since x_1 is nonzero, cancellation proves a=b.

source.place: statement, source note: graded global dimension two of S=k[x_0,x_1] (Koszul resolution of k on the regular sequence x_0,x_1)

proof.text: For g(a,b)=0, apply [lem-sc-p1-linear-syzygy] to obtain c with a=cx_1 and b=-cx_0. Thus (a,b)=f(c). The converse follows from the zero composite, proving Function.Exact f g.

source.place: statement, source note: graded global dimension two of S=k[x_0,x_1] (Koszul resolution of k on the regular sequence x_0,x_1)

proof.text: The quotient kernel is the defining ideal by Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem. Ideal.mem_span_pair identifies membership in (x_0,x_1) with an expression bx_0+cx_1, giving Function.Exact g q; the quotient map is surjective by Submodule.mkQ_surjective. Multiplication of homogeneous elements adds their degrees, and negation and addition preserve degree, so the required degree checks for f and g follow from MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.mul, neg and add and isHomogeneous_X. Finally Set.range X for Fin 2 is {x_0,x_1}. By MvPolynomial.mem_pow_idealOfVars_iff at exponent one, an element belongs to this ideal exactly when all supported monomials have degree at least one. A homogeneous element of degree n+1 satisfies this immediately. Therefore q kills every positive-degree homogeneous element. These computations give every conjunction of the stated resolution; the shift convention is already expressed by its degree n+1 clauses.

lean.statement: theorem koszul_resolution {k : Type u} [Field k] : ∃ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →ₗ[MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k] MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k × MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k × MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →ₗ[MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k] MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (q : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →ₗ[MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k] MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k ⧸ Ideal.span ({X 0, X 1} : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))), (∀ a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k, f a = (a * X 1, -a * X 0)) ∧ (∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k × MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k, g p = p.1 * X 0 + p.2 * X 1) ∧ (∀ a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k, q a = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({X 0, X 1} : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))) a) ∧ Function.Injective f ∧ Function.Exact f g ∧ Function.Exact g q ∧ Function.Surjective q ∧ (∀ a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k, q a = 0 ↔ a ∈ Ideal.span ({X 0, X 1} : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))) ∧ (∀ a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k, g (f a) = 0) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k), a ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n → (f a).1 ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k (n + 1) ∧ (f a).2 ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k (n + 1)) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k × MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k), p.1 ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n → p.2 ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n → g p ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k (n + 1)) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k), a ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k (n + 1) → q a = 0)

reviewed_lean.note: field k (any universe); S=MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k total-degree homogeneousSubmodule (neg. degrees 0) as landed E1 graded-syzygy; f a=(a x1,-a x0), g=(a,b)->a x0+b x1, q=mk onto S/(x0,x1), all S-linear and tied by equations; exactness Injective f, Exact f g, Exact g q, Surjective q; degree zero: S(-2)_{n+2}=S_n -> S_{n+1}^2, S_n^2 -> S_{n+1}, q kills S_{n+1} (quotient in degree 0), via S(d)_n=S_{d+n} of twisting-sheaf (2).
